table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Status of the plan geography (all rows are 'Active' via the Boundary field in the current extract).

table:columns.name: SLUP_LATES
table:columns.description: Strategic Land Use Plan category code (latest designation): NPA Neighborhood Preservation Area, NDA Neighborhood Development Area, NCA Neighborhood Commercial Area, RCA Regional Commercial Area, BIPA Business/Industrial Preservation Area, BIDA Business/Industrial Development Area, IPDA Institutional Preservation and Development Area, ROSPDA Recreational/Open Space Preservation and Development Area, SMUA Specialty Mixed Use Area, OA Opportunity Area (category names from the city's adopted 2005 Strategic Land Use Plan document).

table:columns.name: Boundary
table:columns.description: Whether the geography is the active plan boundary ('Active' in current data).

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the SLUP amendment area the polygon belongs to, where applicable (e.g. '26 Midtown Corridor'); blank for unamended base-plan areas.

table:columns.name: PLANNER
table:columns.description: Planning staff member associated with the amendment record.

table:columns.name: UPDATED
table:columns.description: Date the record was last updated.

table:columns.name: COMMENTS
table:columns.description: Planner's free-text comments on the amendment/designation.

table:columns.name: PDA_RESOLU
table:columns.description: Planning agency resolution reference for the amendment that set this designation (PDA_RESOL_ is the truncated companion field; inferred from name).

table:columns.name: GEOGRAPHY
table:columns.description: List of city block numbers / census identifiers the amendment covers (observed values are space-separated block numbers).

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
